source.title: Deathsilk Belt — first-person twenty disenchant results, archived comment 388442
source.author: Wowhead commenter 388442

quote: I just disencahnted 20 of this, and didnt get any essences.
notes: Original first-person commenter explicitly reports disenchanting 20 Deathsilk Belts (54471) and receiving NO essences. This supports 20 completed DE casts and an observed zero essence-family occurrence in each, but not a specific identified essence item: source does NOT name Lesser Celestial Essence (52718), so outputItemID is intentionally null. The source also claims a 425 Enchanting requirement, NOT the player's measured skill. The same comment's '75 for dust and 25 for essences' is an unverified expectation, never an observed percentage. Dust outcomes, all material stack quantities other than zero essence, historical data date, actual client patch/build, specialization, bonuses, refunds and Retail item eligibility unknown. Original comment repeats across Wowhead retail/Cata/MoP mirrors; this study is recorded once. The Cata Classic page currently shows ilvl289, but that may not match the comment's item instance; do not transfer to current Retail.
outputName: Essences (source did not identify material subtype)
